paragraphs: Vibelly is only for people aged 18 or older. You confirm you are 18+ before every chat. If you are under 18, do not use Vibelly. Accounts found to belong to minors are banned.

paragraphs: You can start a video or text chat without creating an account. Reporting someone requires you to be signed in, so that reports are tied to real accounts and cannot be abused anonymously.

Video and voice calls connect directly between browsers using WebRTC, which encrypts media in transit. When a direct connection is not possible, media passes through a relay server, which forwards it without being able to read it. As with any peer-to-peer video call, the other person can see your IP address, which can reveal your approximate location.

Vibelly does not record calls, and random chat messages are not stored. Direct messages between signed-in users are kept for up to 24 hours (the last 25 per conversation) so you can read them, then deleted.
If you sign in, we store your account details, your Premium status, and the details of any reports you make or receive, so that we can enforce these rules. See the Terms & Privacy Policy for more.

bullets: Never share your full name, address, school, workplace, or financial details.
Skip any conversation instantly. You never owe a stranger your time.

If someone threatens or blackmails you, do not pay. Keep evidence, report the account, and contact your local police.

author.name: Naimish Omar
author.bio: Naimish Omar is the founder of Vibelly, building real-time video and chat apps with WebRTC and writing about online safety and talking to strangers.

paragraphs: Vibelly is built and run by Naimish Omar, an independent developer. Naimish started Vibelly after Omegle shut down in November 2023, to offer random video chat that keeps the fun of meeting strangers while taking safety seriously.
Vibelly is a free random video chat that runs in your browser. You press start and are matched with a stranger for a video or text chat, with no app to install and no account needed to chat.
Vibelly Premium is an optional paid plan. It adds gender and country filters, 720p HD video, and voice-only calls, and it is how Vibelly is funded.

bullets: Vibelly is strictly for adults. You confirm you are 18 or older before every chat.
Every call has a Report button. Reporting requires signing in with Google or GitHub; reports are reviewed by hand, and accounts that break the rules are banned.
Calls connect directly between browsers over encrypted WebRTC and are never recorded.
paragraphs: Read the Safety & Community Rules for the full details.
Questions, feedback, press, or abuse reports: email vibellyofficial@gmail.com.
Omegle closed in November 2023. Vibelly keeps the same idea, a random one-to-one chat with a stranger, and changes the rules around it.

You confirm you are 18 or older before every chat. You can start a video or text chat in your browser without an account. Free video runs at 480p; Vibelly Premium adds gender and country filters, 720p HD video, and voice-only calls.

Every call has a Report button. Reporting requires you to be signed in, so reports are tied to real accounts, and every report is reviewed by hand. Calls are encrypted in transit and never recorded, but as with any peer-to-peer call, the other person can see your IP address.
Want to compare options first? Our blog compares nine Omegle alternatives, including Vibelly, with sources for every claim.

sections.h2: Vibelly and OmeTV: what is different
paragraphs: Both let you video chat with strangers for free. The differences are in the details. OmeTV's own FAQ says it has no gender filters; on Vibelly, gender and country filters are part of Premium. Vibelly runs only in the browser, with no app to install, and you can start a chat without creating an account.

On Vibelly you confirm you are 18 or older before every chat. Signed-in users can report anyone in one tap, and reports are reviewed by hand. Free video runs at 480p, and Premium unlocks 720p HD and voice-only calls.
Every service changes over time, so check each one's current rules before you decide. Our sourced comparison of Omegle alternatives covers OmeTV and seven other services.
Chatroulette launched in 2009 and is free, including a country filter. Vibelly is newer and smaller, so there may be fewer people online at quiet times.

What Vibelly offers: random video and text chat in your browser with no account needed, an age confirmation before every chat, and a Report button on every call. Reporting requires signing in, and reports are reviewed by hand. Vibelly does not use automated AI moderation.
On Vibelly, filters are paid: Premium adds gender and country filters, 720p HD video, and voice-only calls, from ₹49 a month. Free video runs at 480p.
For more options side by side, see our comparison of nine Omegle alternatives, which includes Chatroulette.

sections.h2: How random video chat works on Vibelly
paragraphs: Random video chat pairs you with a stranger for a live, one-to-one video call. On Vibelly, you open the site, confirm you are 18 or older, allow camera and microphone access, and press start. A matching server pairs you with someone who is waiting, then gets out of the way.

The call itself connects directly between the two browsers using WebRTC, which encrypts audio and video in transit. When a direct connection is not possible, a relay server forwards the call without being able to read it. Calls are never recorded.
You can skip to someone new at any time. Free video runs at 480p and adapts to your connection; Premium adds 720p HD, voice-only calls, and gender and country filters.
Ready to try it? Start a chat from the Vibelly homepage.

Talking to strangers is a low-pressure way to practise conversation. Nobody you know is watching, and if a chat does not go well you can simply move on. People use random chat to beat boredom, to hear how life looks in another country, to practise a language with native speakers, or just to have a conversation they could never have predicted.
On Vibelly you can start a free video or text chat in your browser, with no app to install. You confirm you are 18 or older before every chat, and you can skip to someone new at any time.

bullets: "Where are you calling from?" Easy to answer, and it leads somewhere.
"What is the time where you are?" A natural follow-up that often turns into a story.
"What is something you are into that most people do not know about?"
"What food from your country should I try?"
Notice something real: a poster, a guitar, a view. It shows you are paying attention.
paragraphs: After they answer, share something of your own so it feels like a conversation, not an interview. If the chat is not clicking, say "nice talking to you" and skip. Our guide How to Start a Conversation With a Stranger has more ideas.

sections.h2: When to skip, and when to report
bullets: Skip whenever a conversation is not working for you. Skipping is never penalised.
Report anyone who is sexual, abusive, hateful, or appears to be under 18. Reporting requires signing in, and every report is reviewed by hand.
Be wary of anyone who quickly asks you to move to another app or asks for money, codes, or photos. Those are common scam patterns.
Remember the other person can see your IP address on a peer-to-peer call, so never share your full name, address, school, or workplace.

sections.h2: What anonymous chat means on Vibelly
paragraphs: Anonymous chat on Vibelly means you can start a random video or text chat without creating an account, giving an email address, or sharing a phone number. You are matched with a stranger, and neither of you sees a profile, a name, or a follower count unless you choose to share it.

It does not mean invisible. On any peer-to-peer video call, the other person's browser can see your IP address, which can reveal your approximate location. The other person can also record their own screen, so assume anything you show on camera could be saved. Choose a plain background and keep identifying details off camera.

Some features need an account: Vibelly Premium, direct messages, and reporting. Reporting requires signing in with Google or GitHub, so reports are tied to real accounts. Signing in does not show your name or email to the people you chat with.

sections.h2: What is and is not stored
bullets: Random chats: video and voice connect directly between browsers, encrypted in transit, and are never recorded. Random text chat messages are relayed and not stored.
If you sign in: your name, username, email, and profile image from Google or GitHub, the gender and country you choose, your Premium status, and any reports you make or receive.
Direct messages between signed-in users: the last 25 per conversation are kept for up to 24 hours, then deleted.
Payments are handled by Razorpay. Vibelly never sees your card or bank details.
Your IP address is visible to the other person during a peer-to-peer call.
paragraphs: Full details are in the Terms & Privacy Policy.

bullets: Use a first name or nickname only.
Keep your school, workplace, street, and social media handles to yourself.
Be careful with requests to move to another app, or to send photos, money, or codes.
Skip any conversation that makes you uncomfortable, and report anyone who breaks the rules.
paragraphs: For more, read the random video chat safety checklist on the Vibelly blog.
